title: AI Art cannot scroll to Auto-Save AI Images on the phone
repro: 1. Use supplied Release APK b236d639160459eecd60900926c759af5d4ae080 on the API 36 phone, portrait 1080×2400, font_scale 1.0 and Button Size 100%. Switch Wi-Fi and data off.
2. Open Settings → AI Art and enable Create AI Images; do not enter or save any credential.
3. Force-stop/relaunch, reopen AI Art with the persisted enabled preference.
4. Swipe up inside the body (550,1900 → 550,850); try paragraph and side-margin origins too. Try to reach Auto-Save AI Images. Repeat from a fresh process.
expected: The AI Art body scrolls so both Customize AI Style and Auto-Save AI Images can be fully reached and changed.
actual: In both fresh-process trials the Auto-Save switch stays at raw bounds [808,2296][945,1993], beyond the body bottom at 1993; Customize is only a 27 px clipped strip. Neither adb swipes nor a traced, calibrated one-contact uinput swipe moves this section. The identical uinput swipe does move Parent Center in the positive control. This is normal font size; the key field itself remains visible.
suspectedCode: experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/RsdAiSettingsSection.tsx:97 (enabled body inside RsdSectionReveal; native scroll/content extent is suspected, exact cause not isolated)
shipping: Source-only comparison: web/src/lib/components/SettingsModal.svelte:332 defines the phone body with overflow:auto; its AI key manager and feature toggles live in that scrolling body. Host-browser empirical comparison belongs to the separate worker and was not run here.

title: Keyboard focus reaches an unselected Theme segment but cannot activate it
repro: 1. Open Settings → Appearance and select Light on the API 36 phone Release APK b236d639160459eecd60900926c759af5d4ae080.
2. Press Tab until Light is focused; press Right. Dark receives focus.
3. Press Enter, Space and D-pad center separately.
4. Tap Dark as a positive control, restore System, then repeat from a fresh app process.
expected: A keyboard user can select the focused unselected segment. Immediate selection on arrows follows the shared web picker; at minimum an activation key must work after native focus navigation.
actual: Twice, Right focuses Dark but leaves Light checked. Enter, Space and D-pad center all leave Dark unchecked and focused. Dark is exposed as focusable=true but clickable=false. Tapping Dark selects it in both positive controls. System was restored after each trial.
suspectedCode: experiments/native-architecture/src/rsdDrawing/RsdSegmentedPicker.tsx:218 (onKeyDown is only forwarded by react-native-web; unselected native options use tabIndex=-1 and are not keyboard-activatable in this run)
shipping: Source-only: web/src/lib/components/design/SegmentedPicker.svelte:125 moves selection and focus on an arrow. Shared mounted rsd-native-segmented-picker.test.mjs:203 pins that event contract but does not drive real Android key dispatch. Host-browser comparison is owned by the separate worker.

title: Saved PNGs omit drawn ink on the API 28 emulator
repro: 1. Install the supplied Release APK b236d639160459eecd60900926c759af5d4ae080 on API 28 emulator-5684 (1080×2160, density 440), portrait and normal font.
2. Open the tool drawer, choose Purple and Pen, and draw a continuous one-finger line. The supplied repro uses emulator-console kernel events and records contact-down and contact-up.
3. Tap Save screenshot and choose Allow in the real Android storage prompt. Inspect the new PNG under Pictures/Splotch.
4. Repeat from a fresh process and permission baseline; the repro restores both storage permissions, their user flags and the permission preference afterward.

5. For the data-loss path, enable Settings → Saving → Auto-Save on Delete, draw, and drag Clear fully onto the paper. The auto-saved PNG is also paper-only; restarting starts blank as designed. Repeat from a fresh process.
expected: The published PNG includes the purple stroke visible on the paper, as the native export contract and API 36 saved-picture control do.
actual: Twice, permission grants and photo publication succeed, the app remains alive without a fatal/error screen, and the stroke remains visible after Save (10,229 / 10,228 colored pixels in the controlled paper region). Each 1079×1888 exported PNG contains paper texture with zero colored pixels and the same decoded-pixel SHA-256 50097101e17920d1bb60040656369db0d6232051853768abee5530b441d3bb78. Both kernel traces have 62 frames, one down and one up, zero final contacts, maximum move gaps 95.735 / 58.538 ms and maximum jumps 7.641 px. The app shows no save failure. Denied-permission fallback exports also show the omission. Auto-Save on Delete independently reproduces the same omission twice: Clear removes 10,269 / 10,214 colored screen pixels and publishes a PNG with zero colored pixels, without a failure notice. Normal process restart then starts blank and drops Undo by the accepted app contract, leaving no saved copy of that drawing.
suspectedCode: experiments/native-architecture/src/drawing/skiaInkScene.ts:59 (native committed-ink raster capture), then drawing/PictureCapture.tsx:180 (output SVG capture/compose). Exact failing boundary on API 28 is not isolated.
shipping: Source-only: web/src/lib/drawing/engine.ts:1465 snapshots stroke pixels, and exportCompositor.ts:48 draws the overlay into the export. The same candidate on API 36 saves a visible stroke (android-run2-autosaved-output.png). Host-browser comparison belongs to the separate worker.
knownIssueTriage: Distinct from the brief's known-fixed issue 3062 (awaiting file-write completion): these are valid, fully decoded, published PNGs containing paper/grain while all drawn ink is absent. Both storage grants and publication succeed. The exact capture/compose boundary is not isolated.
